title: a launch over its token budget and over its list cap gets one budget_over rule break for each limit and the verdict fail; a second analysis repeats no rule break
intent: INTENDED behavior (TS-ODDITIES R10, defect N-28). analyze checks the launch line's budget: a peak main context above budget.tokens and a list cost above budget.usd_list_cap each append one rule_break of kind budget_over (evidence is numbers only), the analyzed event lists them in rule_breaks, the verdict is fail with the reason `the launch went over its budget` and the summary ends ` (over budget)`; a rule break already in the log with the same evidence is not written again. The oracle never writes budget_over and keeps the verdict, so the stdout and the registry expectations FAIL on TS.

stdout.regex: (?m)^jitso: analyzed L20261113T142233-a3f9: 1 turns, peak 10 tokens, US\$ 0\.006 list, verdict fail \(over budget\)$

fields.evidence: peak context 10 tokens is over the budget of 5 tokens
list cost US$ 0.006 is over the cap of US$ 0.001

fields.verdict_reason: the launch went over its budget
